title: Windowed-MTP: Removing the Full-Context Draft-KV Tax at Million-Token Context
abstract: arXiv:2607.21535v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by having a draft propose tokens that a target verifies in parallel. Frontier models increasingly ship a built-in Multi-Token-Prediction (MTP) draft head, assumed to be cheap beside verification. A shipped full-attention MTP head can become disproportionately expensive beside a hybrid target at long context. The head attends over the full KV cache for each of $\gamma$ draft forwards per decode step, while only 9-25% of target layers retain full attention, so a single draft layer can issue context reads at a rate comparable to the whole target. On hard, low-acceptance workloads, deep native MTP becomes net-negative: slower than no speculation.   We apply a StreamingLLM-style window plus attention sink to the draft only (Windowed-MTP); target verification remains full-context, so the target distribution is preserved. The intervention is training-free and drop-in. On three

translated_title: Windowed-MTP：在百万token长上下文中消除草稿KV缓存的全上下文开销
translated_abstract: 推测解码通过让草稿模型提出候选token、再由目标模型并行验证来加速自回归生成。前沿模型越来越多地内置多token预测（MTP）草稿头，并假设其开销很低。然而在长上下文场景中，随模型附带的全注意力MTP草稿头在与混合架构目标模型配合时可能变得异常昂贵。该草稿头在每个解码步骤的γ次草稿前向传播中都要对完整KV缓存进行注意力读取，而目标模型中仅9-25%的层保留全注意力，因此单个草稿层发出的上下文读取速率可与整个目标模型相当。在接受率较低的困难工作负载上，深层的原生MTP会产生净负收益：比不使用推测解码还要慢。我们仅对草稿部分应用StreamingLLM风格的滑动窗口加注意力汇聚机制（Windowed-MTP）；目标模型的验证仍保持全上下文，因此目标分布得以保留。该方法无需训练、可直接插入使用。在三个……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Windowed-MTP方法，仅对MTP草稿头施加StreamingLLM风格的窗口化注意力加注意力汇聚机制，无需训练即可消除百万token长上下文中草稿KV缓存的高昂读取开销，同时保持目标模型全上下文验证的分布不受影响。
